title: Audit unaligned range-source pointers
changes: Extend the bounded-range exact-pointer census to every byte offset of the authenticated EUR ROM.
validation: Protected census bounded-range-unaligned-pointer-census-l4aomd4j scans all byte offsets for exact little-endian 32-bit pointers into the 88-byte range on mirrors 08, 0a and 0c. It finds the previously known aligned 01abe8 literal and zero unaligned occurrences. The ROM and audit script remain protected; scratch removed.
limitations: Exact byte patterns do not prove execution and do not cover computed or differently encoded addresses, RAM-built pointers, other mappings or indirect reads. Other range consumers and broader validation remain open; no performance measurements.
